title: Compass and Uniform
author: Paloma Whitlock
blurb: Mara Okafor, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
